_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id} ee tuɛm de LinesOfAction.
Yin tuɛm a '{side}', tuɛm ke kɔɔr ee '{other}'.
Kɛ kɛɛm ke: `[b1b3]` (nɛɛŋ latɛɛŋ). Kɛ kɛɛm ciɛɛŋ dɔɔŋ ee kɛɛŋ, ciɛɛŋ dɔɔŋ, ku ciɛɛŋ dɔɔŋ ee tuɛm kɛɛŋ ee kɛɛŋ ciɛɛŋ. Yin kɛɛŋ latɛɛŋ tuɛm yin, ku bɛɛŋ tuɛm ke kɔɔr; latɛɛŋ ee kɔɔr ciɛɛŋ yin.  Yin a win ee tuɛm yin dɔɔŋ ee ciɛɛŋ 8-tɛɛŋ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Pörmat ba e2e4 (kɛ, ɛ wä kä kɔrdi̱nɛtni̱).
invalid_move.identical: Gua̱th in bä kɛ jɛ kɛnɛ gua̱a̱th ɛ wä thi̱n päärkɛ.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Mi̱ ci̱ rɔ wɔ̱ a gɔaa bɛ yiɛth piny ɛ cuŋ kiɛ mi̱ ca guir.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Ba ji̱ yiɛth gua̱a̱ mi päär kɛ min ca la̱t ɛ ti̱ ciɛk.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Kɛn ji̱ tɛ̈r ti̱ti̱ cikɛ duɔ̱ɔ̱p gäk.
invalid_move.destination_own: Gua̱a̱th in wä kɛ ji̱kɛ ɛ jɛn gua̱a̲th ɛmɔ.

game_action.captured_suffix: Riäŋ {player_id} thok {from} -> {to}, tïmëkë ku ën wär.

outcome.win: Kɛn diaal caa kɛ mat kɛɛl.
outcome.draw_repetition: Kä gua̱th ɛmɔ cua loc ni̱ kä diɔ̱k.
